cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial Card Authorization screen renders with header, captions and function-key legend
cases.precondition: F-STD. The operator opens Card Authorization (transaction ORAQ) from the Main Menu.
cases.steps:
1. Enter transaction ORAQ (or select Card Authorization on the Main Menu)
2. Observe the initial screen layout
cases.expected: The header shows Tran: ORAQ, Pgm: OCAUTHQ, title 「ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM」 and the current Date and Time. The captions 「Card Num :」, 「Amount   :」, 「Merchant :」, 「Decision :」, 「Reason   :」, 「Avail Crd:」 are shown, with the legend 「ENTER=Process  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear」 on the bottom line; the entry fields are empty.
cases.remark: UI §2 mockup; BMS MAUTHQ/MAUTHQA SDD-MAP-008 (23 fields); 1000-SEND-INITIAL, 8000-POPULATE-HEADER; WHEAD WS-HDR-TITLE

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: Initial display defaults — empty entry fields, prompt message and live date/time
cases.precondition: F-STD. First entry into the screen (nothing keyed yet).
cases.steps:
1. Open Card Authorization (transaction ORAQ)
2. Check the entry fields and the message line before typing
cases.expected: Card Num, Amount and Merchant are empty; Decision, Reason and Avail Crd are blank; the message line shows 「Enter card, amount, merchant; press ENTER.」; the Date and Time header show the current CICS date/time.
cases.remark: 1000-SEND-INITIAL (MOVE LOW-VALUES TO MAUTHQAO; ERRMSGO prompt); 8500-GET-DATE-TIME (ASKTIME/FORMATTIME)

cases.mid: 表示条件・活性制御 (Display conditions / enable control)
cases.name: Only Card / Amount / Merchant are enterable; result and header fields are display-only
cases.precondition: F-STD. The initial Card Authorization screen is displayed.
cases.steps:
1. Move the cursor across the screen fields
2. Try to type into each field
cases.expected: Card Num, Amount and Merchant accept typing (unprotected, green); Decision, Reason, Avail Crd, the message line and the header fields are protected (skip-over) and cannot be typed into.
cases.remark: UI §2 item-states; BMS attrs — CARDNUM/AMOUNT/MERCH UNPROT/IC/FSET, others ASKIP/NORM

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Card Num left blank is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. The initial screen is displayed.
cases.steps:
1. Leave Card Num blank
2. Enter Amount = 100.00 and Merchant = ACME STORE 01
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card Num = (blank); Amount = 100.00; Merchant = ACME STORE 01
cases.expected: Processing stops before any authorization request is sent; the message line shows 「Card number is required.」; the screen stays on Card Authorization for correction.
cases.remark: 2200-VALIDATE-INPUT L138 (WS-IN-CARD = SPACES/LOW-VALUES); WMSG

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Amount left blank is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. The initial screen is displayed.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111
2. Leave Amount blank
3. Enter Merchant = ACME STORE 01
4. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card Num = 4111111111111111; Amount = (blank); Merchant = ACME STORE 01
cases.expected: The message line shows 「Amount is required.」; no authorization request is sent; the screen stays for correction.
cases.remark: 2200-VALIDATE-INPUT L143 (WS-IN-AMT = SPACES/LOW-VALUES); WMSG

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Amount of zero is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. The initial screen is displayed.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111
2. Enter Amount = 0.00
3. Enter Merchant = ACME STORE 01
4. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card Num = 4111111111111111; Amount = 0.00; Merchant = ACME STORE 01
cases.expected: The message line shows 「Amount must be greater than zero.」; no authorization request is sent.
cases.remark: 2200-VALIDATE-INPUT L149-152 (NUMVAL(WS-IN-AMT) <= ZERO)

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Non-numeric amount is treated as zero and rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. The initial screen is displayed.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111
2. Enter Amount = ABC (non-numeric)
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card Num = 4111111111111111; Amount = ABC; Merchant = ACME STORE 01
cases.expected: The non-numeric amount evaluates to 0, so the message line shows 「Amount must be greater than zero.」; no authorization request is sent.
cases.remark: 2200 L149 FUNCTION NUMVAL(WS-IN-AMT) → 0 for non-numeric; L150 <= ZERO

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: When both Card and Amount are blank, the Card message is shown first
cases.precondition: F-STD. The initial screen is displayed.
cases.steps:
1. Leave Card Num and Amount both blank
2. Enter Merchant = ACME STORE 01
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card Num = (blank); Amount = (blank); Merchant = ACME STORE 01
cases.expected: Only 「Card number is required.」 is shown (the card check runs first and stops validation); the amount message does not appear.
cases.remark: 2200 ordered checks — card (L138) before amount (L142-143 gated by ERR-FLG-OFF)

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Merchant left blank is accepted (merchant is optional)
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 maps to an active account with available credit ≥ 100.00 *(needs real data)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111
2. Enter Amount = 100.00
3. Leave Merchant blank
4. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card Num = 4111111111111111; Amount = 100.00; Merchant = (blank)
cases.expected: Validation passes (merchant is not required); the authorization request is sent and a decision is returned and displayed; the message line shows 「Authorization complete. PF3=Back.」.
cases.remark: 2200 has NO merchant check; 2300-CALL-MQREQ builds AQ-MERCHANT-NAME from spaces

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the entered values and redisplays the blank screen
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card Num, Amount and Merchant have been keyed.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111, Amount = 100.00, Merchant = ACME STORE 01
2. Press PF4
cases.data: Card Num = 4111111111111111; Amount = 100.00; Merchant = ACME STORE 01
cases.expected: All entry fields are cleared and the initial blank screen is redisplayed with 「Enter card, amount, merchant; press ENTER.」; no authorization request is sent.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN DFHPF4 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF3 returns to the Main Menu
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Card Authorization screen is displayed.
cases.steps: 1. Press PF3
cases.expected: Control transfers to the Main Menu (OCMENU); the Card Authorization screen is left without sending any authorization request.
cases.remark: 7000-XCTL-MENU → EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(OCMENU); WS-MENU-PGM

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: An unsupported key shows the invalid-key message
cases.precondition: F-STD. The Card Authorization screen is displayed.
cases.steps: 1. Press an unsupported key (e.g. PF1)
cases.data: Key = PF1
cases.expected: The screen is redisplayed and the message line shows 「Invalid key pressed. Please try again.」; no authorization request is sent.
cases.remark: 2000 EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN OTHER → 1000-SEND-INITIAL + WS-MSG-INVALID-KEY (WMSG) → 8100-SEND-DATAONLY

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: After a decision is shown the screen stays open for another authorization
cases.precondition: F-STD. A first authorization has just completed for Card 4111111111111111.
cases.steps:
1. Complete one authorization (Card 4111111111111111, Amount 100.00, press ENTER)
2. Type a new Card Num = 4222222222222222 and Amount = 250.00 over the fields
3. Press ENTER again
cases.expected: The screen remains on Card Authorization after the first decision; the second ENTER validates and authorizes the new values and shows the new decision — the screen need not be re-opened.
cases.remark: Pseudo-conversational RETURN TRANSID(ORAQ); 9000-RETURN; CA-PGM-CONTEXT=1 → 2000-PROCESS-INPUT

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: A validation error keeps the entered values on screen and clears the result fields
cases.precondition: F-STD. A previous decision may be displayed.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111 and Merchant = ACME STORE 01, leave Amount blank
2. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card Num = 4111111111111111; Amount = (blank); Merchant = ACME STORE 01
cases.expected: The message line shows 「Amount is required.」; the entered Card Num and Merchant remain on screen for correction; Decision, Reason and Avail Crd are cleared.
cases.remark: 2100-AUTHORIZE IF ERR-FLG-ON → 2600-POPULATE-ECHO + clear DECISNO/REASONO/AVAILO → 8100-SEND-DATAONLY

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Approved authorization — sufficient credit on an active account
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 cross-references to an active account (status 'Y') with credit limit 5,000.00 and current balance 1,000.00 → available 4,000.00 *(needs real data)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111
2. Enter Amount = 100.00
3. Enter Merchant = ACME STORE 01
4. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card = 4111111111111111; Amount = 100.00; Merchant = ACME STORE 01; account active, limit 5,000.00, balance 1,000.00
cases.expected: The request is sent over MQ and the decision returns: Decision = 「APPROVED」, Reason = 「APPROVED OK」, Avail Crd = 4,000.00; the message line shows 「Authorization complete. PF3=Back.」.
cases.remark: 2300-CALL-MQREQ LINK OUMQREQ; OUMQREQ 3600-DECIDE WHEN OTHER; 2400-SHOW-DECISION; KAUTH AS-APPROVED

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Declined — requested amount exceeds available credit
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 → active account, available credit 4,000.00 *(needs real data)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111
2. Enter Amount = 5000.00 (above the 4,000.00 available)
3. Enter Merchant = ACME STORE 01
4. Press ENTER
cases.expected: Decision = 「DECLINED」, Reason = 「INSUFFICIENT CREDIT」, Avail Crd = 4,000.00; the message line shows 「Authorization complete. PF3=Back.」.
cases.remark: OUMQREQ 3600 WHEN AQ-AMOUNT > WS-AMT; AS-DECLINED

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Declined — account is inactive
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 → account whose active-status is not 'Y' (e.g. 'C' closed) *(needs real data)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111
2. Enter Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card = 4111111111111111; Amount = 100.00; account status = 'C' (not 'Y')
cases.expected: Decision = 「DECLINED」, Reason = 「ACCOUNT INACTIVE」; the message line shows 「Authorization complete. PF3=Back.」.
cases.remark: OUMQREQ 3600 WHEN AC-ACTIVE-STATUS NOT = 'Y'

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Declined — the cross-referenced account record is absent
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4222222222222222 is present in the card cross-reference but points to an account id that is absent from the account master *(needs real data)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4222222222222222
2. Enter Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card = 4222222222222222; Amount = 100.00; cross-ref present, account master row absent
cases.expected: Decision = 「DECLINED」, Reason = 「ACCOUNT NOT FOUND」, Avail Crd = 0.00; the message line shows 「Authorization complete. PF3=Back.」.
cases.remark: OUMQREQ 3200-READ-ACCT NOTFND → 3400-DECLINE-NOACCT (AS-APPROVED-AMT=0)

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Declined — the card is not in the cross-reference file
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4000000000000000 is absent from the card cross-reference *(needs real data)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4000000000000000
2. Enter Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card = 4000000000000000; Amount = 100.00; cross-ref row absent
cases.expected: Decision = 「DECLINED」, Reason = 「CARD NOT FOUND」, Avail Crd = 0.00; the message line shows 「Authorization complete. PF3=Back.」.
cases.remark: OUMQREQ 3100-READ-XREF NOTFND → 3500-DECLINE-NOCARD

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Available credit is shown as credit limit minus current balance, edited into the Avail Crd field
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 → active account, limit 5,000.00, balance 1,234.56 → available 3,765.44 *(needs real data)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111 and Amount = 100.00
2. Press ENTER
3. Read the Avail Crd field
cases.data: limit 5,000.00; balance 1,234.56; expected available 3,765.44
cases.expected: Avail Crd shows 3,765.44 (= 5,000.00 − 1,234.56), right-aligned in the 15-column field; Decision = 「APPROVED」.
cases.remark: OUMQREQ 3600 COMPUTE WS-AMT = AC-CREDIT-LIMIT - AC-CURR-BAL; OCAUTHQ 2400 MOVE AS-AVAIL-CREDIT→WS-ED-BAL, WS-ED-BAL(2:15)→AVAILO

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Each ENTER sends a fresh authorization request; the screen writes no records
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 authorized once.
cases.steps:
1. Authorize Card 4111111111111111, Amount 100.00 (press ENTER)
2. Without changing the fields, press ENTER a second time
cases.data: Card = 4111111111111111; Amount = 100.00 (submitted twice)
cases.expected: The second ENTER sends another authorization request and shows the decision again; the screen keeps no created/updated/deleted record of its own (display + MQ hand-off only) — there is no duplicate-submit guard.
cases.remark: §5 no DB CRUD; each 2100-AUTHORIZE re-runs 2300-CALL-MQREQ; no idempotence flag

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Backend read failure returns an ERROR decision
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111; the authorizer hits an I/O error reading the account / cross-reference master *(needs real data — force a file error)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111 and Amount = 100.00
2. Press ENTER (with the backend read forced to fail)
cases.data: Card = 4111111111111111; Amount = 100.00; backend read RESP ≠ NORMAL/NOTFND
cases.expected: Decision = 「ERROR」, Reason = 「FILE READ ERROR」; the message line shows the error text 「AUTH ERROR - FILE READ ERROR」.
cases.remark: OUMQREQ 3300 IO-ERROR → AS-ERRORED; 9000-FINALIZE SET CA-ERR-ON + CA-ERR-MSG; OCAUTHQ 2400 IF CA-ERR-ON. No coded msg id — verbatim string is the assertion.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Authorizer link failure returns an ERROR decision
cases.precondition: F-STD, except the MQ authorizer sub-program (OUMQREQ) is unavailable / disabled *(needs real data — disable the linked program)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111 and Amount = 100.00
2. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card = 4111111111111111; Amount = 100.00; OUMQREQ link RESP ≠ NORMAL
cases.expected: Decision = 「ERROR」, Reason = 「LINK OUMQREQ FAILED」; the request is not authorized; a system diagnostic line 「OCAUTHQ: LINK RESP=」 is logged.
cases.remark: OCAUTHQ 2300 ELSE (LINK RESP ≠ DFHRESP(NORMAL)) → AS-ERRORED, AS-REASON, DISPLAY. No coded msg id — verbatim string is the assertion.

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Minimum positive amount (0.01) is accepted
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 → active account with available credit ≥ 0.01 *(needs real data)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111
2. Enter Amount = 0.01
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The amount 0.01 passes the greater-than-zero check; the request is sent and a decision is returned; the message line shows 「Authorization complete. PF3=Back.」.
cases.remark: 2200 L150 WS-AMT-NUM <= ZERO is FALSE for 0.01 — opposite side of UT_AUTH_ABNORMAL_003

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Negative amount (−0.01) is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. The initial screen is displayed.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111
2. Enter Amount = -0.01
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The message line shows 「Amount must be greater than zero.」; no request is sent.
cases.remark: 2200 L150 WS-AMT-NUM (= -0.01) <= ZERO is TRUE

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Maximum amount that fits the field (999,999,999.99) is accepted
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 → active account with available credit ≥ 999,999,999.99 *(needs real data)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111
2. Enter Amount = 999999999.99 (fills all 12 columns)
3. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card = 4111111111111111; Amount = 999999999.99 (12 characters — max for the amount field)
cases.expected: The amount is accepted (> 0) and passed to the authorizer as the numeric value 999,999,999.99; a decision is returned.
cases.remark: AMOUNT field X(12); WS-AMT-NUM S9(09)V99 max 999999999.99; 2200 passes

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A 16-character card number is accepted; the screen applies no length/format check
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 (16 digits) *(needs real data for a live account)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111 (fills all 16 columns)
2. Enter Amount = 100.00
3. Press ENTER
cases.expected: The 16-character card is accepted by the screen (only a blank card is rejected — see UT_AUTH_ABNORMAL_001) and forwarded to the authorizer, which decides by cross-reference lookup; the screen enforces no length / format / check-digit rule.
cases.remark: CARDNUM X(16); 2200 checks only SPACES/LOW-VALUES — blank = min side (UT_AUTH_ABNORMAL_001)

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Amount exactly equal to available credit is approved; one cent more is declined
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111 → active account, available credit exactly 4,000.00 *(needs real data)*.
cases.steps:
1. Authorize Amount = 4000.00 (= available) and note the decision
2. Re-key Amount = 4000.01 (available + 0.01) and press ENTER; note the decision
cases.data: available = 4,000.00; case A Amount = 4000.00; case B Amount = 4000.01
cases.expected: Amount 4,000.00 (= available) → Decision 「APPROVED」 / Reason 「APPROVED OK」. Amount 4,000.01 (> available) → Decision 「DECLINED」 / Reason 「INSUFFICIENT CREDIT」.
cases.remark: OUMQREQ 3600 WHEN AQ-AMOUNT > WS-AMT — strict >, so amount = available is approved (both sides)

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: The authorization request is built and handed to the MQ authorizer over the commarea
cases.precondition: F-STD. Card 4111111111111111, active account *(needs real data)*.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Card Num = 4111111111111111, Amount = 100.00, Merchant = ACME STORE 01
2. Press ENTER
cases.data: Card = 4111111111111111; Amount = 100.00; Merchant = ACME STORE 01
cases.expected: A request of type 「AREQ」 carrying the card number, amount 100.00 and merchant name is passed to the authorizer (OUMQREQ), which sends it over the request queue and returns the decision in the shared work area; the returned decision fields are then displayed.
cases.remark: 2300-CALL-MQREQ builds AUTH-REQUEST (AQ-MSG-TYPE 'AREQ', AQ-CARD-NUM, AQ-AMOUNT, AQ-MERCHANT-NAME); EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM(OUMQREQ) COMMAREA(ORION-COMMAREA); KAUTH
